label: gh pr create → never silent (blocks or emits checklist)
note: Exit code depends on git state: exit 2 (block) when uncommitted changes or zero diff exist, exit 0 (checklist) on a clean pushed branch. Both outputs contain 'PR'. Omit expected_exit to accept either.

label: stack submit -> never silent (blocks on a dirty tree, else emits the stack checklist)
note: Exit code depends on git state: exit 2 when the tree is dirty, exit 0 with the checklist otherwise. Both outputs contain 'STACK'. Omit expected_exit to accept either. Before this hook covered the stack form it exited 0 silently here, which no output assertion could distinguish from a considered pass.

label: trigger quoted in a commit message -> pass through silently
command: git commit -m "docs: when to run gh pr create vs gh stack submit"
note: The guard matches the stripped command, so the commit documenting a rule is not blocked by the rule it documents.
